\usepackage{hyperref}

\usetikzlibrary{arrows.meta, positioning, calc, fit, backgrounds}

\hypersetup{
  colorlinks=true,
  linkcolor=blue!50!black,

\newcommand{\E}{\mathbb{E}}
\newcommand{\Var}{\mathrm{Var}}
\newcommand{\Cov}{\mathrm{Cov}}
\newcommand{\R}{\mathbb{R}}
\newcommand{\Normal}{\mathcal{N}}

\tikzset{
  rnndiagram/.style={
    font=\small,
    line cap=round,
    line join=round,
    >=Latex
  },
  rnninput/.style={
    circle,
    draw=blue!65!black,
    fill=blue!8,
    line width=0.5pt,
    minimum size=8mm,
    inner sep=0pt,
    align=center
  },
  rnnstate/.style={
    circle,
    draw=black!70,
    fill=white,
    line width=0.5pt,
    minimum size=9mm,
    inner sep=0pt,
    align=center
  },
  rnngate/.style={
    circle,
    draw=orange!80!black,
    fill=orange!10,
    line width=0.5pt,
    minimum size=7mm,
    inner sep=0pt,
    align=center
  },
  rnnoutput/.style={
    circle,
    draw=green!55!black,
    fill=green!8,
    line width=0.5pt,
    minimum size=8mm,
    inner sep=0pt,
    align=center
  },
  rnnblock/.style={
    draw=black!18,
    fill=black!3,
    rounded corners=2pt,
    align=center,
    inner sep=6pt,
    outer sep=1pt
  },
  rnnarrow/.style={
    -Latex,
    semithick
  },
  rnnrecur/.style={
    -Latex,
    semithick,
    bend left=32
  },
  rnnskip/.style={
    -Latex,
    semithick,
    dashed
  }
}

\newcommand{\RNNInputNode}[3][]{\node[rnninput,#1] (#2) {#3};}
\newcommand{\RNNStateNode}[3][]{\node[rnnstate,#1] (#2) {#3};}
\newcommand{\RNNGateNode}[3][]{\node[rnngate,#1] (#2) {#3};}
\newcommand{\RNNOutputNode}[3][]{\node[rnnoutput,#1] (#2) {#3};}
\newcommand{\RNNBlockNode}[3][]{\node[rnnblock,#1] (#2) {#3};}

% END_SHARED_PREAMBLE

\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}[rnndiagram, x=1cm, y=1cm]
  \node[rnninput] (x) at (1.0,1.6) {\(x_t\)};
  \node[rnnstate] (hprev) at (1.0,-1.6) {\(h_{t-1}\)};
  \coordinate (join) at (2.2,0);

  \node[rnngate] (z) at (3.3,1.0) {\(z_t\)};
  \node[rnngate] (r) at (3.3,-0.6) {\(r_t\)};
  \node[rnnblock, minimum width=2.8cm, minimum height=1.1cm] (cand) at (6.1,0) {\shortstack{候选状态\\\(\tilde{h}_t\)}};
  \node[rnnblock, minimum width=2.3cm, minimum height=1.1cm] (mix) at (9.0,0) {门控混合};
  \node[rnnstate] (h) at (11.4,0) {\(h_t\)};
  \node[rnnoutput] (y) at (11.4,-1.9) {\(\hat{y}_t\)};

  \begin{scope}[on background layer]
    \node[rnnblock, fit=(z)(r)(cand)(mix), inner sep=9pt] {};
  \end{scope}

  \draw[rnnarrow] (x.east) -- (join);
  \draw[rnnarrow] (hprev.east) -- (join);
  \draw[rnnarrow] (join) -- (z.west);
  \draw[rnnarrow] (join) -- (r.west);
  \draw[rnnarrow] (join) -- (cand.west);
  \draw[rnnarrow] (r.east) -- (cand.west);
  \draw[rnnarrow] (cand.east) -- node[above] {写入} (mix.west);
  \draw[rnnarrow] (z.east) |- (mix.north);
  \draw[rnnskip] (hprev.east) .. controls +(1.8,0) and +(-1.8,-0.8) .. node[below] {保留} (mix.south);
  \draw[rnnarrow] (mix.east) -- (h.west);
  \draw[rnnarrow] (h.south) -- (y.north);
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
